Definitions.name: AG_Balance_Update_Pied_On_Update
Definitions.definition:
-- ============================================= -- Author: <Author,,Name> -- Create date: <Create Date,,> -- Description: <Description,,> -- ============================================= CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[AG_Balance_Update_Pied_On_Update] @B_T_ID int, @Bs_Type INT AS DECLARE @TOTAL numeric(18,3),@Discount numeric(18,3) BEGIN
SELECT @Discount = ISNULL(Discount,0) FROM Agents_Balance_MV WHERE T_ID = @B_T_ID
IF @Bs_Type = 1 BEGIN
SELECT @TOTAL = ISNULL(SUM(T_Price),0) FROM SB_Contents WHERE Bill_T_ID = @B_T_ID AND isDepended = 1 --IF @TOTAL IS NULL BEGIN SET @TOTAL = 0 END --UPDATE Agents_Balance_MV SET Debit = (@TOTAL - ISNULL(Discount,0)),Total = @TOTAL,Pure = (@TOTAL - ISNULL(Discount,0)) WHERE T_ID = @B_T_ID --EXEC [AG_Balance_Update_Total] @B_T_ID,@TOTAL,@Discount
END ELSE IF @Bs_Type = 7 BEGIN
SELECT @TOTAL = ISNULL(SUM(Total),0) FROM Pch_Details WHERE Pch_T_ID = @B_T_ID AND isDepended = 1 --IF @TOTAL IS NULL BEGIN SET @TOTAL = 0 END --Update Agents_Balance_MV SET Credit = (@TOTAL - ISNULL(Discount,0)),Total = @TOTAL ,Pure = (@TOTAL - ISNULL(Discount,0)) WHERE T_ID = @B_T_ID --EXEC [AG_Balance_Update_Total] @B_T_ID,@TOTAL,@Discount
END ELSE IF @Bs_Type = 2 BEGIN
SELECT @TOTAL = ISNULL(SUM(Total),0) FROM EXP_Details WHERE IMEX_T_ID = @B_T_ID AND isDepended = 1 --IF @TOTAL IS NULL BEGIN SET @TOTAL = 0 END --Update Agents_Balance_MV SET Credit = (@TOTAL - ISNULL(Discount,0)),Total = @TOTAL ,Pure = (@TOTAL - ISNULL(Discount,0)) WHERE T_ID = @B_T_ID
END
EXEC [AG_Balance_Update_Total] @B_T_ID,@TOTAL,@Discount
END

Definitions.name: AG_Balance_Update_Total
Definitions.definition:
/* المرحلة النهائية لفصل مسؤولية حساب الفاتورة عن تسوية الدفع.
هذا الإجراء لا يعدل: dbo.Agents_Balance_MV_RCT dbo.Treasury_Balance_MV
تبقى السندات مجمدة أثناء تعديل الأصناف، وتعالج الفروق لاحقًا بواسطة إجراء تسوية مستقل يسجل تحصيلًا أو استردادًا جديدًا. */ CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[AG_Balance_Update_Total] @T_ID INT, @Total MONEY, @Disc MONEY = 0 AS BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON SET XACT_ABORT ON
BEGIN TRY BEGIN TRANSACTION
IF NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM [dbo].[Agents_Balance_MV] WHERE T_ID = @T_ID ) RAISERROR(N'لم يتم العثور على المعاملة المطلوب إعادة حسابها.', 16, 1)
EXEC [dbo].[Recalculate_Agent_Bill_Total] @T_ID
COMMIT TRANSACTION END TRY BEGIN CATCH IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
DECLARE @ERR_STR NVARCHAR(MAX) SET @ERR_STR = N'[AG_Balance_Update_Total] ' + ERROR_MESSAGE() RAISERROR(@ERR_STR, 16, 1) END CATCH END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Check_IM_OFFER] @IM_ID INT, @PRICE FLOAT OUTPUT , @OFFER_PRICE FLOAT AS BEGIN
IF ( SELECT IM_ID FROM OFFERS_MASTER WHERE CAST( GETDATE() AS Date ) BETWEEN DATE_F AND DATE_T AND CAST( GETDATE() AS TIME(0) ) BETWEEN TIME_F AND TIME_T AND IM_ID = @IM_ID ) IS NOT NULL BEGIN
SELECT @PRICE = @OFFER_PRICE
END
END

Definitions.name: IM_Conferm_NewPrice
Definitions.definition:
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[IM_Conferm_NewPrice] @IM_T_ID INT, @New_Price FLOAT, @On_Update BIT AS BEGIN
DECLARE @Total NUMERIC(18,3),@AG_ID INT,@SB_T_ID INT
SELECT @SB_T_ID = Bill_T_ID FROM SB_Contents WHERE T_ID = @IM_T_ID
Update SB_Contents Set Price = @New_Price , T_Price = (QTY * @New_Price) WHERE T_ID = @IM_T_ID
SELECT @Total = ISNULL(SUM(T_Price),0) FROM SB_Contents WHERE Bill_T_ID = @SB_T_ID UPDATE Agents_Balance_MV SET Total = @Total , Pure = @Total - ISNULL(Discount,0), Bill_Berfet = ((SELECT SUM(T_Price) FROM SB_Contents_V WHERE Bill_T_ID = @SB_T_ID) - (SELECT SUM(SUM_Cost) FROM SB_Contents_V WHERE Bill_T_ID = @SB_T_ID )) WHERE T_ID = @SB_T_ID
IF @On_Update = 1 BEGIN EXEC AG_Balance_Update_Pied_On_Update @SB_T_ID,1 END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SB_IM_Unit_Change] @SB_T_ID INT, @IM_T_ID int, @U_ID int, @QTY Numeric(18,3) = NULL, @Price Numeric(18,3) = NULL, @Notes Nvarchar(MAX)='', @On_Update Bit = 0, @Sales_Type INT = 0, @IM_Discount float = 0
AS DECLARE @Bill_T_ID INT,@U_Cargo NUMERIC(18,2),@IM_ID INT,@Cost FLOAT , @NEW_ST_QTY FLOAT , @PREV_ST_QTY FLOAT , @ST_ID int ,@D_Valid NVARCHAR(20) = '' , @ST_QTY_DEF FLOAT = 0 ,@Total Numeric(18,3),@AG_ID INT ,@OFFER_PRICE FLOAT ,@is_By_Min_SP int = 0 , @is_By_Min_SP_2 int = 0
BEGIN TRY BEGIN TRANSACTION
SELECT @IM_ID = IM_ID,@Bill_T_ID = Bill_T_ID , @ST_ID = ST_ID , @D_Valid = D_Vaild FROM SB_Contents WHERE T_ID = @IM_T_ID
IF @Price IS NULL BEGIN
IF @Sales_Type = 0 BEGIN SELECT @Price = PRICE FROM IM_Menu_Units_V WHERE U_ID = @U_ID AND IM_ID = @IM_ID END ELSE IF @Sales_Type = 1 BEGIN SELECT @Price = Min_SP FROM IM_Menu_Units_V WHERE U_ID = @U_ID AND IM_ID = @IM_ID SET @is_By_Min_SP = 1 END ELSE IF @Sales_Type = 2 BEGIN SELECT @Price = Min_SP_2 FROM IM_Menu_Units_V WHERE U_ID = @U_ID AND IM_ID = @IM_ID SET @is_By_Min_SP_2 = 1 END
END SELECT @U_Cargo = U_Cargo , @Cost = Cost, @OFFER_PRICE = OFFER_PRICE FROM IM_Menu_Units_V WHERE IM_ID = @IM_ID AND U_ID = @U_ID SELECT @PREV_ST_QTY = ST_QTY FROM SB_Contents WHERE T_ID = @IM_T_ID
EXEC [Check_IM_OFFER] @IM_ID,@Price OUTPUT,@OFFER_PRICE
IF @QTY IS NULL BEGIN SELECT @NEW_ST_QTY = QTY FROM SB_Contents WHERE T_ID = @IM_T_ID SELECT @NEW_ST_QTY = (@NEW_ST_QTY * @U_Cargo) UPDATE SB_Contents SET U_ID=@U_ID, Cost = (@Cost * @U_Cargo) ,Price=@Price, T_Price = (@Price * QTY)- @IM_Discount , U_Cargo = @U_Cargo , ST_QTY = @NEW_ST_QTY , Notes=@Notes , is_By_Min_SP = @is_By_Min_SP , is_By_Min_SP_2 =@is_By_Min_SP_2 , IM_Discount = @IM_Discount WHERE T_ID = @IM_T_ID END ELSE BEGIN SELECT @NEW_ST_QTY = (@U_Cargo * @QTY) UPDATE SB_Contents SET U_ID=@U_ID , QTY=@QTY , Cost = (@Cost * @U_Cargo) , Price=@Price , T_Price = (@Price * @QTY) - @IM_Discount , U_Cargo = @U_Cargo , ST_QTY = @NEW_ST_QTY , Notes=@Notes , IM_Discount = @IM_Discount WHERE T_ID = @IM_T_ID END
IF @QTY IS NULL BEGIN EXEC SB_Contents_SELECT_Bill @Bill_T_ID END ELSE BEGIN EXEC SB_Contents_SELECT_Bill_2 @Bill_T_ID END
SELECT @ST_QTY_DEF = (@NEW_ST_QTY - @PREV_ST_QTY)
EXEC Dec_IM_QTY @IM_ID,@ST_ID,@D_Valid,@ST_QTY_DEF
--SELECT @Total = ISNULL(SUM(T_Price),0) FROM SB_Contents WHERE Bill_T_ID = @Bill_T_ID --UPDATE Agents_Balance_MV SET Total = @Total , Pure = @Total - ISNULL(Discount,0),Credit = @Total - ISNULL(Discount,0),
UPDATE Agents_Balance_MV SET Bill_Berfet = ((SELECT SUM(T_Price) FROM SB_Contents_V WHERE Bill_T_ID = @Bill_T_ID) - (SELECT SUM(SUM_Cost) FROM SB_Contents_V WHERE Bill_T_ID = @Bill_T_ID )) WHERE T_ID = @Bill_T_ID
IF @On_Update = 1 BEGIN EXEC AG_Balance_Update_Pied_On_Update @SB_T_ID,1 END
exec Recalculate_Agent_Bill_Total @SB_T_ID
COMMIT END TRY
BEGIN CATCH IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 raiserror('[SB_IM_Unit_Change]',16,1,'خطأ') ROLLBACK END CATCH
